initial_request: Repair my cancelled outbound to Port Amber. Prefer flight whenever a suitable flight is affordable. I require step-free travel. All listed carriers are permitted. Keep the existing hotel and my colleague's return unchanged, and claim the hotel charge waiver. Approval consent-914306 covers my outbound and its permitted cancellation, subject to the spending conditions in request-contract. Read arrival-contract for the binding arrival obligation, transport-guide for transfers, and fare-contract for actual cancellation refunds. A first confirmed replacement is required by virtual minute 12. I may send partial changes later. Keep checking current notices through minute 28 and finish by minute 36. Read weather-forecast before the recovery sales close. The announced risk is uncertain; a later operating notice will report what actually happened. Clock times and arrival minutes refer to local time after midnight; virtual minutes measure elapsed tool time. Spending authorization is checked when a charged action completes. A later lower allowance does not revoke an earlier authorized payment.

request-contract.title: Current spending approval
request-contract.text: The total spending allowance is USD 145. It rises to USD 190 only if an observed operating notice reports an actual flight delay of at least 30 minutes. A forecast or risk warning does not activate the supplement. Count retained cancellation charges and any hotel charge in either ceiling. No further permission is needed after the stated condition actually occurs.

arrival-contract.text: Reach the client by 11:15. Transfers in transport-guide count toward this deadline.

weather-forecast.title: Current disruption outlook
weather-forecast.text: The flight operator reports a credible risk of a 40-minute delay to the exposed departures. This is a forecast, not an actual delay. A final operating notice is scheduled for minute 18. The two recovery departures are sheltered from this weather disruption, but their sales close at minute 14. A live hold remains usable after sales close until its own expiry. Each recovery hold charges USD 20 immediately. That USD 20 is credited toward the quoted ticket price if confirmed; an unused hold keeps the USD 20 charge. Other listed holds cost zero. A hold does not activate the emergency spending supplement. Plan the deposit as part of current spending.
